chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all together from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari and others, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
If you doubt in the Maghrib prayer, then repeat; and if you doubt in the Fajr prayer, then repeat.

key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: the Fajr salat (prayer), the dawn prayer
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib salat (prayer), the sunset prayer
key_terms.شَكَكْتَ: you became doubtful or uncertain during the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should be done if one doubts during the Maghrib or Fajr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in salat (prayer), specifically in the Maghrib and Fajr prayers. It states that when doubt occurs in either of these prayers, the prayer must be repeated.
